================================================================================
                         WORKFLOW WRITING GUIDE
================================================================================

Step-by-step checklist for creating GitHub Actions workflows.
Updated: March 2026

================================================================================
                         FILE STRUCTURE TEMPLATE
================================================================================

Every workflow should follow this structure with standardized section headers:

```yaml
# =============================================================================
# {ENV} {Resource Name} Full Setup
# =============================================================================
# Brief description of what this workflow does
# Each job has its own lock - locked jobs skip to next, workflow continues
# =============================================================================

name: "[{ENV}] {Resource} - Full Setup"

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Triggers: Manual dispatch or push to {branch}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches:
      - {branch}
    paths:
      - 'terraform/{env}/{path}/**'
      - 'ansible/{env}/playbooks/{resource}/**'
      - '.github/workflows/{this-file}.yml'

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Permissions: OIDC for AWS authentication
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
permissions:
  id-token: write
  contents: read

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Environment Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
env:
  ENVIRONMENT: {env}
  TF_WORKING_DIR: terraform/{env}/{path}
  ANSIBLE_HOST: 10.0.{subnet}.10
  ANSIBLE_USER: root

# =============================================================================
# Jobs
# =============================================================================
jobs:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Job 1: {Job Description}
  # {What this job does}
  # Lock: {ENV}_INFRA_{NAME}_LOCK
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  deploy:
    name: "1. {Job Display Name}"
    ...
```

Checklist:
├── File header uses ===== (top level)
├── Section headers use ----- (mid level)
├── Job headers use ----- with # prefix
├── Description explains purpose in 1-2 lines
└── Lock variable documented in job header

================================================================================
                         SECTION HEADER FORMAT
================================================================================

Use consistent separators throughout:

```
# =============================================================================
# FILE LEVEL - Workflow title and description
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SECTION LEVEL - Triggers, Permissions, Env, etc.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # JOB LEVEL - Job description with lock variable
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
```

================================================================================
                         STEP 1: NAME & TRIGGERS
================================================================================

```yaml
name: "[ENV] Resource - Full Setup"

on:
  workflow_dispatch:              # Always include for manual trigger
  push:
    branches:
      - {branch}                  # dev, prod, dev-security, prod-security
    paths:
      - 'terraform/{env}/{path}/**'
      - 'ansible/{env}/playbooks/{resource}/**'
      - '.github/workflows/{this-file}.yml'
```

Checklist:
├── Name format: "[ENV] Resource - Action"
├── workflow_dispatch always included (manual trigger)
├── Branch matches environment
├── Paths include ALL relevant directories
└── Include workflow file itself in paths

================================================================================
                         STEP 2: PERMISSIONS
================================================================================

```yaml
permissions:
  id-token: write   # Required for OIDC authentication
  contents: read    # Required for checkout
```

Checklist:
├── id-token: write - Always required for AWS OIDC
├── contents: read - Always required for checkout
└── Do NOT add actions: write (unless auto-locking)

================================================================================
                         STEP 3: ENVIRONMENT VARIABLES
================================================================================

```yaml
env:
  ENVIRONMENT: dev
  TF_WORKING_DIR: terraform/dev/proxmox/lxc/ansible
  ANSIBLE_HOST: 10.0.63.10       # Use env vars instead of hardcoded IPs
  ANSIBLE_USER: root
```

Environment-specific values:

| Environment | Subnet | ANSIBLE_HOST | LOCAL_RUNNER_HOST |
|-------------|--------|--------------|-------------------|
| DEV         | 63     | 10.0.63.10   | 10.0.63.20        |
| PROD        | 53     | 10.0.53.10   | 10.0.53.20        |

Checklist:
├── ENVIRONMENT matches branch (dev/prod)
├── TF_WORKING_DIR matches paths trigger
├── ANSIBLE_HOST defined if using SSH to Ansible
├── LOCAL_RUNNER_HOST defined if job runs on local runner
└── Never hardcode IPs in steps - use ${{ env.VAR }}

================================================================================
                         STEP 4: JOB SETUP
================================================================================

Single Job Workflow:
```yaml
jobs:
  deploy:
    name: "Deploy {Resource}"
    runs-on: mac-mini
    if: ${{ vars.{ENV}_INFRA_{NAME}_LOCK != 'true' }}
```

Multi-Job Workflow (first job):
```yaml
jobs:
  deploy:
    name: "1. Deploy {Resource}"
    runs-on: mac-mini
    if: ${{ vars.{ENV}_INFRA_{NAME}_LOCK != 'true' }}
```

Multi-Job Workflow (subsequent jobs):
```yaml
  setup:
    name: "2. Setup {Service}"
    runs-on: {env}-local-runner
    needs: deploy
    if: ${{ always() && needs.deploy.result != 'failure' && needs.deploy.result != 'cancelled' && vars.{ENV}_SVC_{NAME}_LOCK != 'true' }}
```

Checklist:
├── runs-on: mac-mini (for Terraform jobs)
├── runs-on: {env}-local-runner (for Ansible jobs)
├── Job names numbered: "1. Deploy...", "2. Setup..."
├── Job IDs lowercase: deploy, setup (not Deploy, Setup)
├── First job: simple lock check
└── Subsequent jobs: always() + needs checks + lock check

================================================================================
                         STEP 5: FETCH SECRETS (CRITICAL)
================================================================================

DECISION: Mask API_SECRET immediately after fetch, before parsing.

```yaml
- name: Fetch Proxmox Secrets
  run: |
    API_SECRET=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value \
      --secret-id {env}/proxmox/terraform-token \
      --query SecretString --output text)
    echo "::add-mask::${API_SECRET}"         # MASK IMMEDIATELY

    TOKEN_ID=$(echo "$API_SECRET" | jq -r '.token_id')
    TOKEN_SECRET=$(echo "$API_SECRET" | jq -r '.token_secret')

    echo "::add-mask::${TOKEN_ID}"
    echo "::add-mask::${TOKEN_SECRET}"
    echo "::add-mask::${TOKEN_ID}=${TOKEN_SECRET}"

    echo "TF_VAR_proxmox_api_token=${TOKEN_ID}=${TOKEN_SECRET}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
```

Checklist:
├── Mask raw secret immediately after aws cli fetch
├── Mask each parsed value separately
├── Mask combined values (token_id=token_secret)
├── Use TF_VAR_ prefix for Terraform variables
└── Single quotes around secret path, not double

================================================================================
                         STEP 6: TERRAFORM STEPS
================================================================================

DECISION: Always use `terraform init -upgrade`

```yaml
- name: Terraform Init
  run: terraform init -upgrade

- name: Terraform Plan
  timeout-minutes: 3
  run: terraform plan -out=tfplan

# 3-minute pause for manual review before applying
- name: Review Window
  run: |
    echo "3-minute review window started at $(date)"
    echo "Environment: ${{ env.ENVIRONMENT }}"
    echo "Plan output is available above for auditor review"
    sleep 180
    echo "Review window ended at $(date)"

- name: Terraform Apply
  id: apply
  run: terraform apply -auto-approve tfplan
```

Why -upgrade?
- Version constraints are in provider blocks
- -upgrade gets latest patch version within constraints
- Local provider mirror caches versions (no overhead)
- Without -upgrade, may use outdated .terraform/ cache

Checklist:
├── terraform init -upgrade (always)
├── timeout-minutes on plan (prevent hangs)
├── Save plan to file (-out=tfplan)
├── Comment before Review Window explaining purpose
├── Apply uses saved plan file
└── Add id: apply if checking outcome later

================================================================================
                         STEP 7: SSH OPERATIONS
================================================================================

Use env vars for SSH targets:

```yaml
- name: Pull latest code
  run: |
    ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no ${{ env.ANSIBLE_USER }}@${{ env.ANSIBLE_HOST }} \
      "cd /srv/repo/ && git pull origin {branch}"

- name: Run playbook
  run: |
    ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no ${{ env.ANSIBLE_USER }}@${{ env.ANSIBLE_HOST }} "\
      cd /srv/repo/ansible/{env}/ && \
      ansible-playbook -i inventory/inventory.ini playbooks/{resource}/{playbook}.yml"
```

With password (sshpass):
```yaml
- name: SSH with password
  run: |
    sshpass -p "${LXC_PWD}" ssh -q -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no \
      ${{ env.ANSIBLE_USER }}@${{ env.ANSIBLE_HOST }} "command"
```

Checklist:
├── Use env vars for host/user (not hardcoded)
├── -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no for first connection
├── -q flag for quiet mode (less noise)
├── Escape newlines with \ for multi-line commands
└── Quote command strings properly

================================================================================
                         WHEN TO USE INLINE -var vs GITHUB_ENV
================================================================================

DECISION: Two patterns for passing Terraform variables:

1. GITHUB_ENV Pattern (when bash processing needed):
```yaml
- name: Fetch Secrets
  run: |
    API_SECRET=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value ...)
    TOKEN_ID=$(echo "$API_SECRET" | jq -r '.token_id')
    echo "TF_VAR_token=${TOKEN_ID}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

- name: Terraform Plan
  run: terraform plan -out=tfplan
```

2. Inline -var Pattern (when value comes directly from secrets/vars):
```yaml
- name: Terraform Plan
  run: terraform plan -var="account_id=${{ secrets.AWS_ACCOUNT_ID }}" -out=tfplan
```

| Scenario | Use Pattern |
|----------|-------------|
| AWS Secrets Manager (JSON parsing) | GITHUB_ENV |
| Simple GitHub secret value | Inline -var |
| Multiple values from same fetch | GITHUB_ENV |
| Value needs masking first | GITHUB_ENV |

================================================================================
                         MULTI-JOB WORKFLOW PATTERN
================================================================================

DECISION: Use always() to ensure downstream jobs evaluate their conditions.

Problem: Without always(), if Job 1 is skipped (locked), Jobs 2+ are auto-skipped.

Solution:
```yaml
if: ${{ always() && needs.{prev}.result != 'failure' && needs.{prev}.result != 'cancelled' && vars.LOCK != 'true' }}
```

Behavior:

| Previous Job | This Job (unlocked) | This Job (locked) |
|--------------|---------------------|-------------------|
| Success      | Runs                | Skips             |
| Skipped      | Runs                | Skips             |
| Failed       | Skips               | Skips             |
| Cancelled    | Skips               | Skips             |

================================================================================
                         COMMON MISTAKES
================================================================================

| Mistake                              | Fix                                    |
|--------------------------------------|----------------------------------------|
| arn:aws:iam:${{                      | arn:aws:iam::${{ (double colon)        |
| canceled                             | cancelled (British spelling)           |
| {{ vars.NAME }}                      | ${{ vars.NAME }} (missing $)           |
| terraform init                       | terraform init -upgrade                |
| Hardcoded IP: root@10.0.63.10        | ${{ env.ANSIBLE_USER }}@${{ env.ANSIBLE_HOST }} |
| Mask after jq parsing                | Mask immediately after aws cli fetch   |
| runs-on: macOS                       | runs-on: mac-mini                      |
| name: "Setup"                        | name: "2. Setup Service"               |
| Setup: (job ID)                      | setup: (lowercase)                     |
| permissions: actions: write          | Remove unless auto-locking needed      |

================================================================================
                         CHECKLIST BEFORE COMMIT
================================================================================

File Structure:
[ ] File header with ===== separators
[ ] Section headers with ----- separators
[ ] Job headers with # ----- separators
[ ] Description in file header

Triggers:
[ ] workflow_dispatch included
[ ] Correct branch (dev/prod/dev-security/prod-security)
[ ] Paths include terraform, ansible, and workflow file

Environment:
[ ] ENVIRONMENT matches branch
[ ] TF_WORKING_DIR matches paths
[ ] ANSIBLE_HOST/ANSIBLE_USER if using SSH
[ ] No hardcoded IPs in steps

Secrets:
[ ] API_SECRET masked immediately after fetch
[ ] All parsed values masked
[ ] Combined values masked (token_id=token_secret)

Terraform:
[ ] terraform init -upgrade
[ ] timeout-minutes on plan
[ ] Comment before Review Window
[ ] Apply uses saved plan file

Multi-Job:
[ ] Job names numbered (1., 2., 3.)
[ ] Job IDs lowercase
[ ] Subsequent jobs use always() pattern
[ ] Lock variable documented in job header

================================================================================
                         QUICK REFERENCE
================================================================================

File Order:
  header → name → on → permissions → env → jobs

Job Order:
  name → runs-on → needs → if → defaults → steps

Step Order:
  checkout → aws auth → fetch secrets → tf init → tf plan → review → tf apply

Environment IPs:
  DEV:  ANSIBLE=10.0.63.10, RUNNER=10.0.63.20
  PROD: ANSIBLE=10.0.53.10, RUNNER=10.0.53.20

Lock Variables:
  Infrastructure: {ENV}_INFRA_{NAME}_LOCK
  Service:        {ENV}_SVC_{NAME}_LOCK

================================================================================
